ai_summary: Here's an executive summary based on the provided document:  AAA Technologies Limited announced the resignation of its Managing Director and Chairman, Mr. Venugopal Dhoot, effective August 31, 2026. This departure, which also includes his cessation from all board committees, is explicitly stated to be due to the execution of a Share Purchase Agreement (SPA) and a contemplated change in company ownership/control. Both the company and Mr. Dhoot confirmed there are no other material reasons for his resignation, indicating a strategic transition under new stewardship rather than undisclosed issues.
